repo.description:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server exchanges subscription interest with cluster routes and leafnodes, including information about queue subscribers.

### Problem Description

A route or leafnode peer could advertise a queue subscription weight that caused excessive memory allocation when matching messages. The work occurred while holding a subscription-list lock and could stall message delivery or terminate the server through memory exhaustion. An attacker requires access to a route or leafnode connection accepted by the server.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.9 and v2.15.2. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-27c4-m7hq-v6pw>
 * Credit: thc1006 (蔡秀吉)
repo.summary: Remote queue subscription weights can exhaust server memory
